info.title: OctoCAT Supply Chain Management API
info.description: A comprehensive REST API for managing supply chain operations including suppliers, products, orders, deliveries, and branch locations. Built with Express.js, TypeScript, and SQLite.

get.description: Retrieves a list of all branch locations in the supply chain network. Branches are linked to headquarters and can place orders.

200.description: List of all branches retrieved successfully

post.description: Creates a new branch location. The branch must be associated with an existing headquarters.

requestBody.description: Branch data to create. The branchId is auto-generated and should not be provided.

409.description: Conflict - headquarters does not exist or constraint violation

get.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific branch location by its unique identifier.
